_comment0: TEMPLATE — copy to moraa.config.json and edit there. NEVER commit the real file: it is where real API keys live. Check .gitignore covers moraa.config.json before putting a real key anywhere in this file.
_comment1: PRECEDENCE for every setting: CLI flag > environment variable > this file > built-in default. A layer only wins when it actually provides a value.
_comment2: SECRETS: keys are NEVER printed anywhere; config-check and all logs show at most the last 4 characters. Prefer environment variables (MORAA_AI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ZAI_API_KEY, SNYK_TOKEN) over putting keys in this file.

ai._comment3: TWO INDEPENDENT OPT-IN MODES. Both DEFAULT TO OFF. With both off, nothing AI-related runs and no API key is required anywhere.
ai._comment4: provider: none | auto | anthropic | openai | zai | local (local = any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; set ai.baseUrl). 'auto' resolves a provider only from whichever single key is present, and only for an explicitly enabled mode.

report._comment5: MODE 1 — 'report': post-processes an ALREADY-PRODUCED review (the Markdown projection + data/report.json), pulls the code snippet at each finding's line, and enriches each finding's own Markdown section IN PLACE with an unverified narrative. Idempotent: AI content lives inside stable markers and is replaced whole on re-run.

review._comment6: MODE 2 — 'review': direct code review. The AI reads source files and produces findings attributed to tool 'ai-review'; they enter the canonical model and correlate like any other tool's findings. An AI finding never overrides, suppresses or outranks a tool finding; disagreements are recorded, never resolved.

keys._comment7: Provider keys. Placeholders only here — replace in your LOCAL moraa.config.json, or better, keep them in the environment.

tools._comment8: Per-adapter toggles consumed by the orchestrator (enabled !== false keeps an adapter in the run).

ai-review._comment9: Legacy pre-2.0 shape, still honoured: enabled here acts on MODE 2 ('review') only. Prefer ai.review.enabled.
